scope: Primary-source method evidence for the next kiki algorithm and training design; no new real-data fit or prediction

sources.title: Nonlinear state-space identification using deep encoder networks
sources.venue: PMLR 144:241-250, Learning for Dynamics and Control
sources.verified_with: Publisher proceedings page and paper PDF
sources.supported_claim: A causal encoder can initialize short simulation sections within a system-identification objective.
sources.project_boundary: An encoder is already present in A04. This supports the modelling formulation, not a new contribution or guaranteed 100 ms identifiability.

sources.title: Continuous-time identification of dynamic state-space models by deep subspace encoding
sources.verified_with: Native arXiv metadata through Sider Scholar and primary HTML, section 4 and appendix 8.2
sources.supported_claim: Continuous-time state and derivative scaling affect numerical conditioning. Reconstructing an initial hidden state from past inputs and outputs requires observability conditions.
sources.project_boundary: Physical COI coordinates and energy parameterizations must be transformed consistently. These conditions cannot certify unknown kiki hidden states from a finite window.

sources.title: Deep Subspace Encoders for Nonlinear System Identification
sources.verified_with: Native arXiv metadata through Sider Scholar and primary HTML
sources.supported_claim: Truncated simulation losses, initial-state estimation and system timescales interact in state-space identification.
sources.project_boundary: Long stable trajectories cannot be split into many training sections without declaring a sampling rule and preserving event and line weights. More sections are not independent disturbances.

sources.title: Initialization Approach for Nonlinear State-Space Identification via the Subspace Encoder Approach
sources.supported_claim: A best linear approximation and its reconstructability map can initialize both state dynamics and the encoder in the studied weakly nonlinear benchmarks.
sources.project_boundary: A04 already uses a constrained visible-momentum initialization. The paper motivates checking initialization; it does not establish which initialization improves this power-system task.

sources.title: Data-driven identification of latent port-Hamiltonian systems
sources.supported_claim: Jointly learned latent coordinates and structured port-Hamiltonian matrices can preserve the chosen model structure by parameterization.
sources.project_boundary: Their latent reduction does not prove transient accuracy or a stability region for an unknown kiki system. Keep this project's explicit energy and COI checks.

sources.title: jax-sysid author-maintained implementation
sources.verified_with: Author repository README, nonlinear training and regularization sections
sources.supported_claim: The implementation separates initialization, regularization and optimization settings, and exposes grouped penalties and staged optimizers.
sources.project_boundary: Use explicit fixed budgets and separate changes. Do not copy examples that reconstruct a new sequence's initial state with future outputs, or import a general stability constraint that suppresses physical loss of stability.

interpretation: These sources motivate testable design choices. None supplies evidence of improved kiki performance, independent test validity or a Level 6 certificate.
